title_en: Technology and Engineering (6/20): The Power Grid Control Center
note_en: 着 (zhe) after a verb marks an ongoing state or action: 大屏幕上，显示着整个城市的用电情况 "the big screen shows the whole city's power use," 密切关注着 "keeping a close eye on." English uses the -ing form or the simple present for this; Chinese has no tense, so 着 does the work of saying "this is in progress right now."

sentences.en: Liu Wei explained that the control center's SCADA system collects voltage, current, and load data from every substation in real time, and as soon as a line becomes overloaded, the system automatically launches a load transfer plan, shifting power to a neighboring backup line to keep the grid running stably.
